#### IsBulkNotSupportedFailure

```text
public static System.Boolean IsBulkNotSupportedFailure(PPDS.Dataverse.BulkOperations.BulkOperationResult result, System.Int32 totalRecords)
```

Determines if a bulk operation failure indicates the entity doesn&#x27;t support bulk operations.

- Parameter `result`: The bulk operation result.
- Parameter `totalRecords`: The total number of records attempted.

Returns: True if the failure indicates bulk operations are not supported.

Remarks: Some entities (like team, queue) don&#x27;t support CreateMultiple/UpdateMultiple/UpsertMultiple. When detected, callers should fallback to individual operations. Error messages vary by entity: &quot;is not enabled on the entity&quot; (team) &quot;does not support entities of type&quot; (queue)
